TABLE.NAME: block_activity_copy_cart_job
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per 'Copy Activities' click - the async copy job's own record of what to copy and how far it's gotten, entirely independent of $SESSION once queued.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The teacher who started the copy - the adhoc task runs as this user (set_userid()), and this is also who the job belongs to for privacy/ownership purposes.

FIELD.NAME: cart
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON snapshot of the parsed cart (see app\block\manager::build()), so the job is self-sufficient once queued.

FIELD.NAME: targetcourseids
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of already-validated target course ids (see app\target\courses_tree::filter()).

FIELD.NAME: totalunits
FIELD.COMMENT: count(cart items) * count(target courses), computed once at creation.

FIELD.NAME: failuremessage
FIELD.COMMENT: Set only when status = failed: why the whole job (not just one unit) stopped.

TABLE.NAME: block_activity_copy_cart_bkp
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per distinct cart item in a job - each item is backed up exactly once (see copy\backup), then every target course's restore (copy\restore) reuses the same backupid, instead of re-backing up the same activity once per target course.

FIELD.NAME: backupid
FIELD.COMMENT: backup_controller's own id once the backup succeeds; null until then.

FIELD.NAME: message
FIELD.COMMENT: Why the backup failed; empty otherwise.

FIELD.NAME: timecleaned
FIELD.COMMENT: Set once every target course has consumed this backup and its temp files were deleted (backup_helper::delete_backup_dir()).

TABLE.NAME: block_activity_copy_cart_res
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per (cart item x target course) unit once processed - drives both 'what's left to do' (idempotent chunk selection) and the progress page's log.

FIELD.NAME: newcmid
FIELD.COMMENT: The copied activity's cmid in the target course, if the copy succeeded.

FIELD.NAME: message
FIELD.COMMENT: Why it was skipped or failed; empty for success.
